title: Final Hamiltonian
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the Hamiltonian must be correctly derived as H = sqrt((p - qA/c)^2 c^2 + m0^2 c^4).

title: Lagrangian Definition
description: Important Criteria: The Lagrangian must be correctly defined as L = -m0 c^2 / gamma - qPhi + (q/c) v · A.

title: Momentum Expression
description: Important Criteria: The canonical momentum must be correctly expressed as p_i = m0 gamma dot{x}_i + (qA_i/c).

title: Velocity Components
description: Important Criteria: The velocity components must be correctly identified as v = (dot{x}_1, dot{x}_2, dot{x}_3).

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes when substituting expressions for momentum and velocity.
